Three moments sum to zero; their determinant is the square root of a 2×2 PSD Gram determinant. If the largest density is at least one half, the two smaller moments saturate the perpendicular product cap. Otherwise the cap triangle is acute, the concavity supporting plane has strictly positive coefficients, and the three consecutive arc construction attains its area. Both branches match on their boundary. Concavity of log sine gives the unique global equal-third optimizer. The packaged checker passed 12,316 supplementary finite tests; it is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sharp constrained norm quantifies how disjoint effects of a nonprojective covariant operator-valued measure fail to commute. Every allocation of the three outcome densities is classified, with a sharp threshold at maximum density one half, explicit geometrically distinct extremizers, and an unconditional global constant with unique maximizing density. This solves a natural fixed-marginal operator-measure extremal, rather than an arbitrary finite table or a routine bound.
